name: Sparse Voxel Rasterization
definition: A real-time high-fidelity radiance field rendering system that integrates an efficient rasterizer with a multi-level sparse voxel scene representation, reconstructing scenes from multi-view input images by adaptively fitting sparse voxels into different levels-of-detail.
summary: Sparse Voxel Rasterization is a real-time volumetric rendering technique that rasterizes explicit sparse voxels in an octree layout, avoiding neural MLP overhead and dense pointer grids.
